jobs_results.title: Analista-Científico/a de Datos y Gestión de Proyectos.
jobs_results.description:
Título del Puesto: Analista-Científico/a de Datos y Gestión de Proyectos.

Ubicación: Sur de Gran Canaria, España. Formato de trabajo híbrido.

Descripción del Puesto:

En The Wise Dreams, estamos buscando un/a Analista-Científico/a de Datos con experiencia en Qlik Cloud y habilidades en Gestión de Proyectos para unirse a nuestro equipo en el sur de Gran Canaria. El candidato ideal será apasionado por el análisis de datos, con una sólida comprensión de las metodologías estadísticas, experiencia en programación y capacidad para liderar equipos multidisciplinarios.

Responsabilidades:
• Recolectar, procesar y analizar datos de diversas fuentes para analizarlos y procesarlos con el fin de mejorar las operaciones, la toma de decisiones y experiencia del cliente.
• Coordinar equipos internos y externos para llevar a cabo proyectos conjuntos utilizando metodologías ágiles.
• Diseñar y construir visualizaciones de datos efectivas utilizando Qlik Cloud y otras herramientas de BI.
•... Automatizar procesos mediante la generación de scripts para la optimización de tareas repetitivas y procesos de análisis de datos.
• Interpretar datos complejos y presentar hallazgos de forma clara y comprensible para interesados no técnicos.

Requisitos: cualificaciones académicas, experiencia y habilidades técnicas:
• Grado o Máster en Matemáticas, Estadística, Ciencias de Datos o un campo relacionado.
• Experiencia demostrable en el uso de Qlik Cloud para análisis y visualización de datos, asi como conocimiento de servicios de cloud storage para manejo y almacenamiento de datos (por ejemplo Google Cloud, Snowflake, AWS, Azure…).
• Experiencia mínima de 1 año en roles de Data, preferiblemente en el sector hotelero.
• Conocimiento práctico de herramientas y lenguajes de programación como Python, SQL y Qlik Cloud y con librerías como Pandas y Numpy.
• Fuertes habilidades analíticas y capacidad para trabajar con conjuntos de datos complejos.
• Experiencia previa en el sector hotelero es deseable.
• Certificaciones en Ciencia de Datos y/o en herramientas de Cloud Storage son un plus.

Habilidades Blandas:
• Excelente capacidad de comunicación para colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios y comunicar hallazgos técnicos de manera clara y efectiva a audiencias no técnicas.
• Trabajo en equipo y habilidad para autogestionarse.
• Empleo de metodologías de trabajo como Lean, Scrum, Agile, etc.
• Poseer un enfoque de mejora continua, utilizando un pensamiento crítico y analítico para evaluar procesos actuales, identificar áreas para mejora y aplicar soluciones de manera proactiva.

Esta oferta combina la experiencia en análisis de datos con habilidades en gestión de proyectos, lo que permitirá al candidato contribuir tanto en el análisis de datos como en la coordinación de equipos para lograr los objetivos del proyecto

jobs_results.title: Master Data
jobs_results.description:
Estamos seleccionando un Master Data para nuestro departamento de Control de Gestión Industrial.La persona seleccionada se encargará de cargar y mantener los datos maestros actualizados en nuestro ERP, garantizando el proceso y los flujos de información asociados.

Buscamos un perfil que aporte experiencia en implantación de SAP, carga de datos maestros y seguimiento del arranque.

¿Tienes experiencia como Master Data? ¿Te consideras una personas proactiva, comunicativa, organizada y metódica?

Te encargarás de:
• Ejecutar el alta y la gestión de los artículos en el maestro de materiales del ERP.
• Ejecutar el alta de las nuevas listas de materiales.
• Mantener, actualizar y gestionar las listas de materiales, tanto las nuevas como las versiones existentes.
• Asignar y mantener los datos necesarios para el correcto etiquetado y arte final de componentes y palets, relacionda con cada uno de los clientes.

Se trata de una posición estable, ofrecemos incorporación en una empresa en pleno... proceso de expansión y que apuesta por las personas.

Requisitos:
• Valorable formación superior: Lic.Documentación, Ing.Organización Industrial, otras titulaciones afines. Valorable formación postgrado tipo Master SAP.
• Imprescindible aportar experiencia previa como Master Data en empresas sector industrial.
• ERP SAP.
• Nivel EXCEL alto

jobs_results.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs_results.description:
Desde LHH Recruitment Solutions buscamos un/a Data Scientist 100% remote para unirse a una empresa de soluciones de inteligencia artificial.

Si te interesa el mundo del aprendizaje automático, los modelos de lenguaje y estás listo para trabajar en proyectos desafiantes, ¡queremos conocerte!

¿Qué perfil estamos buscando?
• Mínimo 2 años de experiencia como Data Scientist.
• Experiencia imprescindible en Large Language Models (LLMs). Conocimiento en modelos de lenguaje específicos, como Azure OpenAI, modelos de OpenAI (como GPT-3, GPT-4) y LLama.
• Experiencia en Machine Learning.
• Conocimientos sólidos programando en Python.
• Experiencia en modelos de Procesamiento de Lenguaje Natural (NLP), incluyendo el uso de librerías específicas como NLTK, SpaCy o Gensim, así como marcos como TensorFlow, PyTorch y Keras.
• Familiaridad con Langchain (muy valorable)
• Familiaridad con metodología agile

¿Qué te podemos ofrecer?

📝Contrato indefinido dentro de un proyecto estable

⌚️Horario... flexible. Jornada intensiva en verano

☀️27 días laborables de vacaciones

💼 Modalidad de trabajo 100% remoto

📚Formación y certificaciones proporcionadas por la empresa

💰Banda salarial según la experiencia entre 40.000€- 50.000€ + variable

📍Oficinas en Madrid

¡Si cumples con estos requisitos y estás buscando un nuevo desafío en el área de la inteligencia artificial, no dudes en aplicar en la vacante o enviar tu CV actualizado a arianna.infranco@lhh.com

jobs_results.title: Manager de Monetización y Análisis Estratégico - Departamento de Yield
jobs_results.description:
Misión del Departamento: El Departamento de Yield de PRISA Media desempeña un papel crucial en la optimización estratégica y operativa de los flujos de ingresos publicitarios a través de nuestro portafolio de productos. Aprovechando los datos sobre productos, inventario y audiencia, nuestra misión es maximizar la rentabilidad de nuestros espacios publicitarios y contribuir significativamente a los ingresos de la compañía.

Resumen del Rol: Como Manager de Monetización y Análisis Estratégico en el Departamento de Yield, serás fundamental en la explotación de datos de audiencia e inventario para potenciar nuestras propuestas publicitarias. El foco de tu trabajo será la realización de análisis y tareas vinculadas a la explotación del dato. Tus análisis impulsarán las ventas e informarán sobre las ofertas de productos, impactando directamente en los objetivos financieros de PRISA Media. Reportarás directamente al Director de Yield y trabajarás en sinergia con los equipos comerciales, de... datos y adtech para asegurar un enfoque cohesivo hacia la optimización de ingresos.

Responsabilidades Clave:
• Analizar y cruzar datos de audiencia con inventario para identificar oportunidades de monetización.
• Generar perfiles de usuario para propuestas comerciales personalizadas.
• Diseñar segmentaciones específicas para campañas publicitarias.
• Elaborar propuestas de insights a partir del portafolio de productos de datos.
• Mantenimiento evolutivo de datasets.
• Gestionar cuadros de mando para la toma de decisiones basadas en datos.
• Proyecciones semanales y reportes de cierre mensuales.
• Conciliar datos generados con la facturación y seguimiento de ingresos de datos.
• Optimizar floor prices.
• Preparar y actualizar estructuras de previsión y proyecciones presupuestarias.

Capacidades/Conocimientos:
• Definición y construcción de cuadros de mando en herramientas como Looker, Power BI o Tableau.
• Utilización de herramientas de análisis de datos digitales como Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics o Amplitud.
• Utilización de herramientas de análisis de datos de inventario y rendimiento de este como Adomik, Google DV360 o Google Ad Manager.
• Entendimiento del ecosistema de compra programático.
• Entendimiento del ecosistema de datos e identidad dentro del ámbito de la venta publicitaria digital.
• Experiencia en la extracción de conclusiones en base a datos.
• Se valorarán conocimientos avanzados de análisis mediante la utilización de lenguajes como Python, R o el uso de SQL para la extracción y procesado de datos.
• Habilidad para presentar datos de manera narrativa y comprensible (Storytelling con data).
• Capacidad para trabajar en colaboración con equipos multifuncionales.
• Fluidez en inglés para la colaboración con nuestros partners tecnológicos.

Cualificaciones:
• Grado universitario en un campo relevante o experiencia equivalente.
• Experiencia mínima de 3 años en un rol similar, preferiblemente en entornos de medios de comunicación, agencias o tecnología publicitaria.
• Experiencia demostrable en generar insights que impacten en el negocio.
• Agilidad y eficacia en la explotación del dato.
• Experiencia en el análisis del comportamiento de los usuarios en el entorno digital con foco en la identificación de patrones para su clusterización

jobs_results.title: Billing Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Colt DCS provides true service and operational excellence in the sustainable design build delivery and operational management of hyperscale data centres across Europe and APAC We provide data centre solutions to hyperscale and large enterprise customers across 17 state of the art carrier neutral data centres spanning 7 cities.

Our hyperscale and colocation solutions allow our customers freedom to plan effectively for the growth of their business knowing that their data centre strategy is ready for the demands of tomorrow We have over 25 years of experience in the industry delivering on our vision of being the most trusted and customer centric data centre operator in the market We put environmental awareness at the heart of everything we do because we know its the right thing to do for our planet Thats why were taking the ownership to reduce our environmental impact globally and make sustainability a key strategic driver. As part of our sustainability journey Colt DCS has set... comprehensive near and long term Science Based Targets to cut our emissions in line with the SBT is latest Net Zero Standard.

Role Title

Billing Analyst

Colt Band

PT1

Department

DCS Billing – Customer Experience

Reporting To

Team Leader, Hyperscale Admin & Governance

Role Location:

Role Purpose

The Billing Resolution Team is the first point of contact for our customers in relation to Billing queries.

While providing the highest level of customer service, the Billing Analyst answers all Billing queries and provides first line support and communication to DCS customers. The Billing Analyst is responsible for ensuring a systematic, disciplined and process driven approach to managing customer issues and requests whilst ensuring agreed procedures and standards are met.

Key Accountabilities
• Responsible for dealing with all the issues generated at the end of the Lead to Bill cycle until resolution and communications (via email and phone) with customers.
• Responsible for managing all admin change requests (Novations, Transfer of Service, Legal address change etc)
• Responsible for raising Financial Adjustments orders (Credit Notes) and cease and replacing orders in our CRM system when linked to a Billing Ticket.

What We Offer

Colt DCS is a growing business that is investing in its people Our people are defined by their ability to make things happen and deliver on their promises We offer skill development learning pathways and accreditation to help our people perform at their best regardless of role and location.

In addition to offering competitive salaries and incentive plans a range of benefits and local rewards packages are offered to staff Colt DCS recognises the importance of a work life balance.

Some benefit examples are
• Pension and insurance options
• Access to a virtual business school for ongoing learning
• Business mentoring
• Discounts with local hospitality and retail providers
• Flexible working and relaxed dress code
• Two days annually to spend on volunteering opportunities

jobs_results.title: Checkout Data Analyst (They/She/He) - (Hybrid)
jobs_results.description:
As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We're seeking an experienced Checkout Data Analyst to join our Checkout team in Barcelona (hybrid), which is passionate about data, automation, analysis and innovation and loves to work in a collaborative and agile environment. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform and one of the largest e-commerce businesses in Europe.

20 million customers – 44 markets – 5 brands – 5.4M members in Prime

16.2 million bookings FY23 - More than 50,000 bookings per day - 100 million daily user searches

1400 employees – More than 50 different nationalities - 99% permanent contracts - 36.3 average age

We're a leading travel tech company, revolutionising the travel booking experience through our consumer insight, innovative technology, market leadership, and Prime, the world's first travel... subscription program.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Checkout Data Analyst in the Checkout team you will be in charge of:
• Responsible for execution of key analysis, being the data entry point for the business team and taking ownership of the different data sources from the business side. Understand the business needs, gather the data and present the key insights
• Own team metrics identifying the drivers of over and underperformance and providing data driven recommendations for how we can improve the KPIs performance
• Turn business questions into functional analysis, extract relevant and actionable insights working with data from many different data sources using SQL/BQ and work with your stakeholders to make them happen
• Elaborate business cases to support strategic product decisions
• Design and execute measurement experiments; Analyse performance and user behaviours in the A/B Tests experiments or Pre-Post run by the business stakeholders

jobs_results.title: Data Architect
jobs_results.description:
ClearPeaks is a specialist consulting firm delivering services and solutions in "Everything Data" - Business Intelligence, Advanced Analytics, Big Data & Cloud, and Web & Mobile Applications. Founded in 2000, we have been a trusted partner to our customers in over 15 industry verticals and functional areas, with operations spanning Europe, Middle East, the United States, and Africa.

ClearPeaks is part of a strategic alliance with synvert, a group of six successful full-service Data & Analytics (D&A) consulting firms, with a clear goal to become one of EMEA's largest D&A consulting companies.

Our services are based on the latest market-leading enterprise technology platforms, and delivered by a dynamic team of expert consultants. Our strength lies in our ability to efficiently deliver customer insight and value, gained through our decades of experience with real-world challenges.

As a Data Architect, you will design BI solutions to deliver the best quality projects to our clients... world-wide. At ClearPeaks, there are endless opportunities to get involved in different projects bringing innovative ideas while being part of leading-edge teams who are always innovating and evolving in the BI field.

Responsibilities
• Define and manage achievable project and resource plans in a fast moving and dynamic environment.
• Plans, manages, and keeps control over key project milestones, issues and risk proposes, metrics and success factors.
• Ensure project objectives and scope are clearly defined, understood by impacted stakeholders
• Manage and execute requirements gathering phases of a project
• Coordinate and execute solution analysis and design with the entire project team
• Coordinates and participates in solution testing to guarantee high quality of BI solutions, ensuring compliance to validation and testing requirements, including appropriate documentation.

Requirements

Ideally Computer Science Engineering, Informatics, Statistics or other degree with interest in the business intelligence field.

Fluent and articulate in English

Minimum of 5 years of experience in the BI field with the ability to:
• Requirements gathering knowledge and experience, incl. wireframe prototyping
• Design and implement BI business logic and security models

Technical skills:
• Experience working with dimensionally modelled data such as good understand of DWH concepts
• Proven ETL experience, preferably on Informatica PowerCenter or SQL Server Integration Services.

Customer oriented with excellent communication and presentation skills.

Proactive, team player, committed and constant willingness to improve.

Analytical, problem solving and creative.

Able to pick up on new data tools and concepts quickly.

Our offer to you!
• Be part of an international and talented team, enjoying an excellent work environment where people are passionate about what they do.
• Attractive salary according to experience and knowledge provided.
• Flexible working schedule
• 23 vacation days + 24 & 31 December

jobs_results.title: Data Scientist (Remote in Barcelona)
jobs_results.description:
About us:

Have you always wanted to put your passion for education to use on the job? Would you like to work with an incredible team making an impact on learning around the world? If you answered yes, we can't wait to meet you!

And just who are we? Edpuzzle is a leading edtech company with offices in San Francisco and Barcelona and nearly 10 years of history helping teachers find and create exciting, interactive video lessons. Over 80% of U.S. schools and millions of teachers and students in 190+ countries around the world are already using Edpuzzle to make education more equitable and engaging.

About the role:

We’re looking for our next Data Scientist to join the Data & Analytics team in Barcelona. You’ll be responsible for adapting techniques from research to specific clients and research problems. You will advise on technical and theoretical possibilities within the data science domain and report and present research findings and developments clearly and efficiently, both... internally and externally, verbally and in writing.

Wondering what it’s like to work at Edpuzzle?

Picture a place where you can connect with your teammates, whether remotely or in person, whenever you need support. A place where one day you're helping shape one of the biggest edtech platforms in the world, and the next day you're doing a teambuilding activity with your coworkers. A place where everyone has been selected because they're the best at what they do, and where your manager and team trust your decisions fully. A place where you're encouraged to learn and grow because education is the cornerstone of everything we do. Check out the job details below to see if Edpuzzle could be the right fit for you!

About the job
• Identify valuable data sources and automate collection processes.
• Extract and query data from our data lake and data warehouse – undertake the preprocess of structured and unstructured data.
• Analyze large amounts of information to discover trends and patterns, and interpret and analyse data problems.
• Propose solutions and strategies to business challenges.
• Collaborate with the Engineering and Product teams.
• Build analytic systems and predictive models.
• Derive insights from our customer’s behaviours and journeys to facilitate activities for acquisition, engagement, and retention.

About you:
• You have at least 3 years of proven experience as a Data Scientist or in a similar role.
• Graduate degree in Data Science or another quantitative field preferred; BSc/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• You are able to work with big amounts of data identifying patterns and relationships.
• You can organise, store, protect data, and present it in an accurate and understandable manner.
• You have deep knowledge of Python and their most useful libraries.
• You can work with relational and non-relational databases.
• You have proven experience managing projects handling multiple stakeholders, identifying constraints, and organising processes to maximise efficiency.
• Strong mathematical skills.
• Your are based in Barcelona or near Barcelona.

Bonus skills
• Familiarity with Javascript language.
• Experience working with AWS console.
• Experience using business intelligence tools (e.g. Tableau).
• Experience with NewRelic.
• … or another amazing skill you bring to the table that we haven’t thought of yet!

What’s it like to work remotely?
• Work from the comfort of your own home
• Use the Edpuzzle office in Barcelona as much or as little as you like
• Meet with your manager and team via video calls on Google Meet or Slack
• Connect with coworkers via Slack (with channels for work and for fun!)
• To enjoy our remote work policy, you’ll need high-speed internet access

What we offer:
• Competitive salary at €‎36,000 - €‎43,000 and a yearly salary review based on performance
• Free private health insurance policy with AXA
• €2000 annually for meals
• Flexible remuneration for childcare and transportation
• Training and development (CodelyTV, etc.), we love keeping ourselves updated!
• 24 paid holidays plus December 24th and 31st
• Flexible working hours and reduced working time on Fridays
• Remote-friendly: Feel free to work 100% remotely or use the Barcelona office whenever you want, for the best of both worlds!
• Free coffee, snacks, and drinks in the Barcelona office
• Teambuilding events during working hours
• Incredible opportunity to grow, learn, and build lifetime bonds with other passionate people

Edpuzzle is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Edpuzzle makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

References from previous employers will be requested from candidates during the selection process. If you'd like to be considered for this position, please apply below. We look forward to hearing from you

jobs_results.title: Swedish Language Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
TELUS International is looking for a Language Data Analyst in Barcelona, Spain to work onsite for a machine learning project! At the moment, we are looking for candidates with fluency in Swedish, for a temporary position of undefined duration.

As a Language Data Analyst you oversee the curation and management of data. You ensure that the AI systems have access to high-quality, diverse, and relevant data to enable accurate and ethical decision-making.

Main Responsibilities:
• Identify, gather and process relevant data from various sources, ensuring its quality, accuracy and integrity
• Implement data cleaning, transformation and enrichment processes to optimize data usability for AI models
• Adapt language to fit a particular culture or market (localization)
• Translate content from English to your mother tongue

Competencies:
• Giving support, focusing on customers, embracing technology, managing self-development
• No people management accountabilities
• Ability to perform curation... cleaning and transformation processes
• Excellent data analysis skills
• Good troubleshooting and problem solving skills
• Familiarity with bias mitigation techniques and ethical considerations in AI
• Basic knowledge in programming languages and relevant libraries

Qualifications:
• Experience in data annotation or data labeling is a plus
• Educational background in Linguistics, Literature, Translation or equivalent in a plus
• Proficient English oral and written
• Proficient in Swedish, oral and written

What we offer:
• Meal vouchers
• Referral program with attractive bonuses
• Private medical insurance for employees and relatives
• Great office at a top location
• Positive international working environment (relaxing zones, terrace, kitchen)
• Discounts in gym memberships
• Career development opportunities
• No overtime or weekend work
• Continuous support and learning
• Access to counseling sessions

If this opportunity sounds appealing to you, apply now! Kindly attach your CV in English.
• Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

About us:

AI Data Solutions

Creating and enhancing the world's data to enable better AI via human intelligence.

We strive to enhance the world's data to enable better AI through human intelligence. Our team of data, technology, and project management professionals work with companies to test and improve machine learning models. We handle various data types, including text, images, audio, video, and geo. Our solutions improve AI systems in multiple applications, such as advanced smart products, improved search results, expanded speech recognition, more human-like bot interactions, and more.

TELUS International values diversity and grants equal opportunity regardless of age, civil status, disability, gender, nationality, race, religion and political beliefs, sex or sexual orientation.

Additional Job Description

TELUS International is looking for a Swedish Language Data Analyst in Barcelona, Spain.

Language Reference

Swedish

EEO Statement

At TELUS International, we enable customer experience innovation through spirited teamwork, agile thinking, and a caring culture that puts customers first. TELUS International is the global arm of TELUS Corporation, one of the largest telecommunications service providers in Canada. We deliver contact center and business process outsourcing (BPO) solutions to some of the world's largest corporations in the consumer electronics, finance, telecommunications and utilities sectors. With global call center delivery capabilities, our multi-shore, multi-language programs offer safe, secure infrastructure, value-based pricing, skills-based resources and exceptional customer service - all backed by TELUS, our multi-billion dollar telecommunications parent.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At TELUS International, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity
